messages:
anya: FYI — vendor sync notes pulled from today. Need quick decision on staggered GA windows for H100/H200, MI300, and Gaudi.

mike: ran the calc on capacity. If we stagger by region + SKU we avoid a single-day surge, but ops needs lead time for kernel images.

jordan: question — do we want marketplace listings to go live on the same GA date as partner press? partners prefer a 48–72h buffer.

rachel: +1 on buffer. Marketing asked for a single cadence doc they can hang PR on. Can we commit to an announce window per vendor?
suresh: from infra: firmware gating for some Gaudi builds will likely land late May. That pushes internal cert by ~10 days unless partner provides signed binaries earlier.
mike: ok — so propose: H100 -> early May (region-limited), MI300 -> mid-May, Gaudi -> end-May for GA. Staggered, with marketplace soft-listing 48h after partner embargo lifts.

anya: that sounds actionable. Two asks: 1) SI integrators need a dry-run week before GA to validate their onboarding scripts, and 2) we need signed kernel/image tags from partners before we flip marketplace to active.

jordan: SI dry-run is critical. Can we reserve lab capacity week of Apr 28? Ops: how's lab load?
suresh: lab has a maintenance window Apr 25–26 but Apr 28–May 2 is mostly clear if we prioritize. We'll need to freeze unrelated CI for that week.

rachel: Marketing will prep embargo copy. Who owns the embargo window tracker? I can but need a canonical doc link to update.
mike: I'll create a simple tracker in the partnerships drive and add owners per vendor + region. Will include: GA date, marketplace soft-listing, SI dry-run, firmware signoff, press cutoff.

anya: also flagging a compatibility risk: some quantized variants on H200 need a newer runtime ABI; need runtime team to test the marketplace packaging path.
suresh: noted. I'll queue a runtime smoke test against the packaging flow — can run on Apr 22. If we hit failures, we either delay H200 region or push an interim image.

jordan: for enterprise customers, Sales asked for a predictable SLA start date. Can we map SLA start to marketplace active date+7d?
mike: yes that gives a buffer for rollback if we hit post-GA issues. I'll annotate that in tracker.

rachel: PR draft timeline: need final messaging by May 1 to hit partner embargo schedule.

anya: summary actions: mike -> create tracker & owners; suresh -> runtime smoke test Apr 22 + reserve lab Apr 28–May 2; jordan -> scope SI dry-run checklist; rachel -> PR draft by May 1. I'll ping partners to confirm embargo offsets.

deploy-bot: build-notify: marketplace-image-build queued for h100-beta (id: bld-8812).

mike: putting owners on calendar invites now. If partners confirm earlier image signing we can compress the schedule, but plan for the conservative stagger.

anya: thanks team — we'll reconvene next Tue to lock dates after partners respond. :thumbsup:
